name: burp
blurb: A corpus of Hungarian business-lunch menus, plus the pipeline that keeps collecting them.

name: Foursquare Exports
blurb: Pull your own Foursquare lists back out into something you keep.

name: MC-101 Firmware Analysis
blurb: SysEx parameter mapping for the Roland MC-101 and MC-707, recovered by reading the firmware.

name: soobrosa likes
blurb: A serverless page listing everything I have liked on SoundCloud.

name: check-games
blurb: Cross-references a game wishlist against Steam, GOG, Humble and Epic, then scores every owned title for Apple Silicon. This is the pipeline; it has no interface of its own.

name: Mixes Player
blurb: A self-hosted grid player streaming two decades of DJ mixes from R2.

name: RaveDownloads
blurb: 4,168 rave tapes and radio rips, 369.8 GB, filterable by artist, year and genre. The audio itself lives on archive.org.

name: The Blockbuster Meter
blurb: An interactive dashboard that scores what to watch tonight. Built in Tableau in 2012.
